text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: One day, while walking along the riverbank――

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Um... Excuse me.
Do you have a moment?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Could you please time my run?
It's quite difficult to do properly on my own...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Though overwhelmed by Silence Suzuka's sheer speed, I helped her with her training.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Give it my all... Yes, understood.
I'm counting on you, then.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Silence Suzuka tore past at blistering speed... and simply kept running off into the distance.
